sense.text: This was left out of last week's class, so add it to last week's notes. “And the Lord said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof.” That is the men that are keeping the commandments. That is the mark, so they don't get killed.

“And to the others he said in mine hearing, Go ye after him through the city, and smite:” Smite means kill. “let not your eye spare,” Don't spare him. “neither have ye pity:” Don't have no pity. Slay utterly old and young, both maids and little children and women. We know some squirm over that part, but look at the first part of the verse: in mine hearing. Why does he say in mine hearing? What happens when somebody is smiting you, killing you? What are you doing? God wants to hear people scream. He wants to hear men scream, old people scream, women scream, babies scream. He wanted to hear them scream.

“And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.” There were seven seals on this book. Most of the seals have been done, so today we complete the seals, but that ain't the end of the series. Before Revelation 6, it is prefaced with the precept chapter, Zechariah 6.

“And I turned, and lifted up mine eyes, and looked, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.” Zechariah sees a vision: he sees chariots. Chariots are what Esau calls UFOs; we call them IFOs, identifiable flying objects. They flew between two mountains. The two mountains are explained in Deuteronomy 27:12-13: when we were in the wilderness there were two huge mountains, and God split Israel up. These tribes go on this mountain to send forth the blessings, and the rest of you tribes go on the other mountain and bring forth the curses that come if you break God's commandments.

“In the first chariot were red horses;” The first chariot Zechariah sees is red. “and in the second chariot black horses;” The second, he sees black horses. “And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.” Write this word down: grisled. Grisled and bay goes into the pale horses.

“Then I answered and said unto the angel that talked with me, What are these, my lord? And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before the Lord of all the earth.” Write this down: the four spirits are the first four seals which are opened in Revelation 6.

“The black horses which are therein go forth into the north country; and the white go forth after them;” Write this down: the north country is making reference to Babylon the great, or North America. Zechariah 2:6-7 says ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north; the Lord is telling Israel to flee from North America, spiritually, mentally, the same thing Revelation 18:4 says, come out from among her, my people. Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon: the daughter of Babylon is not the ancient Cushites, it is Edom, the so-called white man (Psalms 137:7-8). And that Zion is mainly Judah. “and the grisled go forth toward the south country.” That is going into South America.

“And the bay went forth, and sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth: and he said, Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth. So they walked to and fro through the earth.”

“Then cried he upon me, and spake unto me, saying, Behold, these that go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.” That lets you know that Israel would be in the north country; the bulk of Israel would be in North America. What does it mean, he quieted our spirit on this side? It means they shut us up. Lucifer, the so-called white man, said in his heart I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north, meaning North America (Isaiah 14:12-13): when it says they sit upon us, he conquered us in North America. That goes with they have quieted my spirit in the land of the north: they conquered us.

precepts.why: This explains the two mountains. “These shall stand upon mount Gerizim to bless the people, when ye are come over Jordan; Simeon, and Levi, and Judah, and Issachar, and Joseph, and Benjamin: And these shall stand upon mount Ebal to curse; Reuben, Gad, and Asher, and Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.” When we went in the wilderness there were two huge mountains, and God split Israel up. He said these tribes go on this mountain to send forth the blessings, and the rest of you tribes go on the other mountain and you bring forth the curses that come if you break God's commandments.

The north country is Babylon the great, North America. “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north,” So the Lord is telling Israel to flee from the land of the north; this is North America. It is saying the same thing Revelation 18:4 says, come out from among her, my people, making reference to Babylon. Flee, meaning flee spiritually, mentally. “saith the Lord: for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the Lord.” Because he spread us worldwide; that is the four winds of the heaven.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Now he says deliver thyself, O Zion. Somebody may say, wait a minute, the daughter of Babylon, isn't that the ancient Cushites? No, it is not; Psalms 137 shows it is Edom. The land of the north is what you want to highlight: land of the north, North America. And that Zion right there, listen good, is mainly Judah.

Who is the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon,” See what it is calling Edom: the daughter of Babylon. This is the so-called white man. “who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” So when we go back to Zechariah 2:7, deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon, that daughter of Babylon is Edom.

What does it mean that they quieted our spirit in the north country? It means they shut us up. “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer,” Lucifer is the so-called white man. You have been taught that Lucifer is some spiritual demon, but Lucifer here is talking about the so-called white man. People get stupid about fallen from heaven: see, he was up in the sky with God. Lamentations 2:1 says God cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel; that doesn't mean we were flying in the sky. It means we were at one time the top nation on earth and we fell to hell, meaning captivity, a low estate. So it is the same context: Lucifer is going to fall from heaven. Remember Revelation 18, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; it is talking about the same thing.

“son of the morning!” Lucifer means light-bearer. You ever see the Statue of Liberty? She is holding up a torch, meaning she is a light-bearer for the world: you want knowledge, you want wisdom, you want anything, you come here. That is America's message. “how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!”

“For thou hast said in thine heart,” This is what Lucifer, the so-called white man, Babylon, says. “I will ascend into heaven,” Meaning they will concoct and create a way to get up to space. “I will exalt my throne above the stars of God:” 1969, the first moon landing. People get stupid: oh, they never went to the moon, it's impossible, there is something around the earth's atmosphere that prevents you from passing it. My jailhouse Negroes: did the white man create airplanes? Yeah. So this other part in the Bible about space is fake? You stupid as hell; go sit your black behind down somewhere. Why is Trump creating a Space Force if you can't go up there? Stop listening to black people.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:” That is what we wanted right there. In the sides of the north, meaning North America. So what did he do when it says they sit upon us? He conquered us in North America. That goes with Zechariah 6:8, they have quieted my spirit in the land of the north: they conquered us.

The Israelites explain this fall from heaven. “How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel,” So he cast the Israelites down from heaven. Does that mean we were flying in the sky? No, it does not. It means we were at one time the top nation on earth, and we fell to hell, meaning captivity, a low estate. So when Isaiah 14:12 says how art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, it is in the same context: your friendly neighborhood white man is going to fall from heaven.

sense.text: “And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals,” The Lamb is Christ: John the Baptist said behold the Lamb of God (John 1:36). People get dumb as hell; these damn Christian commentaries are dumb as hell. “and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.” He opened one seal and said come and see; let's see what John the Revelator saw here on the island of Patmos.

“And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.” This white horse went forth conquering and to conquer. How many crowns did he have on his head? One crown. This is going into the rise of Babylon, which begins with Esau establishing Babylon the great in the north country.

White generally symbolizes righteousness, so many Christian commentaries say this might be Christ. This is not talking about Christ, because Christ is the one that opened the first seal. This is going into a man that would portray himself as righteous, conquering. It was given unto him to make war with the saints, the children of Israel, and to overcome them, and power was given him over all kindreds, tongues and nations (Revelation 13:7; Psalms 148:14). Write this down: the white horse goes back to the same white horse of Zechariah 6:3, wherein this man would go forth and conquer. Why does it say white? Christ warned that many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ, and shall deceive many (Matthew 24:4-5).

The Spanish conquest shows it. The new world was called America after Amerigo Vespucci, who traveled along the coast of South America; that is the south country, because they went through the south country first, conquering the Incas, the Mayans and the Aztecs, and worked their way up to the north country. The Spaniards were excited with the new land, some wanting to become rich, others to spread their religion: they all came allegedly in the name of white man Jesus, conquering. Explorers and conquerors: conquistadors like Hernan Cortes and Francisco Pizarro didn't want to explore, they wanted to conquer the land and own it, money and gold for themselves and their king, and they fought until they won. Montezuma believed the Spaniards were gods; a war began, many Aztecs died from the smallpox the conquistadors introduced, and though Cortes had only 600 soldiers he defeated the Aztecs. A hundred years after the conquest the Aztec population had decreased from 25 million to one million. Damn.

Habakkuk 1:6-11 spoke of this very same thing: the Chaldeans are a metaphor for the so-called white man Esau, that bitter and hasty nation marching through the breadth of the land from south to north, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs, their horsemen coming from far, Spain, flying as the eagle, the symbol of Spain, coming all for violence to conquer the twelve tribes of Israel, gathering the captivity, scoffing at the kings, deriding every stronghold of the Incas and the Mayans; and then his mind changes and he imputes his power unto his god, Cesare Borgia as Jesus Christ. After he raped, robbed, pillaged and destroyed, he said come to Jesus, Jesus loves you. The curses are upon us for a sign and a wonder, upon our seed for ever (Deuteronomy 28:46), so the conquering constantly happens, and God's words are double in meaning (Job 11:6). That is why all these various precepts explain verse 2.

precepts.why: I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals: this is the precept for the Lamb, because people get dumb as hell; Christians make me sick, these damn Christian commentaries are dumb as hell. What is the Lamb? “And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!” That is what we wanted. So in Revelation 6:1 the Lamb is talking about Christ.

White generally symbolizes righteousness, so many Christian commentaries say the white horse might be Christ. This is not talking about Christ, because Christ is the one that opened the first seal. This is going into a man that would portray himself as righteous, conquering. “And it was given unto him” We want to know about this him. “to make war with the saints,” The saints are the children of Israel (Psalms 148:14): to make war with the Israelites. “and to overcome them:” To overcome, or to conquer them. “and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” Not only did he overcome and conquer the Israelites, he had power over all kindreds, tongues and nations.

Who are the saints? You are going to find out the Bible is redundant; Revelation is very redundant. The same thing the New Testament says is always said in the Old Testament as well. “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel,” So the children of Israel are the saints. So in Revelation 13:7, to make war with the saints is to make war with the Israelites.

Write this down: the white horse goes back to Zechariah 6:3. “And in the third chariot white horses;” So this white horse goes back to the same white horse of Zechariah 6:3, wherein this man would go forth and conquer.

Why does it say white? Christ warned us about something. Remember what Zechariah said: they went forth into the land of the north. “And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” The Spanish conquest: the new world was named America after Amerigo Vespucci, another explorer who traveled along the coast of South America, the south country, because when they started they went through the south country first, conquering the Incas, followed by the Mayans and the Aztecs, working their way up to the north country. Thousands of Spaniards sailed to the Americas hoping to get what they wanted, some to become rich, others to spread their religion. See them down there praying: they all came allegedly in the name of white man Jesus. That is what they did; they came in the name of Jesus, conquering. Conquistadors like Hernan Cortes and Francisco Pizarro didn't want to explore; they wanted to conquer the land and own it, money and gold for themselves and their king, and they fought until they won. Montezuma believed the Spaniards were gods; a war began, many Aztecs died from smallpox, a disease the conquistadors introduced, and even though Cortes only had 600 soldiers he defeated the Aztecs and began a new government in the name of Spain. A hundred years after the conquest the Aztec population had decreased from 25 million to one million. Damn.

This white horse had a crown, had a bow, and went forth conquering and to conquer, and the prophet Habakkuk spoke about this very same thing. “For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans,” The Chaldeans are the upper echelon, the elite of the ancient Cushites, but this goes beyond the Cushites: this is a metaphor, a similitude for the so-called white man, Esau, like Deuteronomy 28:46 says, the curses are a sign and a wonder upon our seed for ever, and God's words are double in meaning (Job 11:6). “that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land,” From south towards the north. “to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.” Didn't the conquistadors do that? You better believe they did this thing. That is why Esau is called the daughter of Babylon.

“They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.” That goes with another scripture, the pride of their heart has deceived them. “Their horses also are swifter than the leopards,” Yes, they came with horses. “and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far;” Meaning Spain. “they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.” It is letting you know their symbol: the symbol of Spain was the eagle.

“They shall come all for violence:” They didn't come for spices; God says they came for violence, to conquer the twelve tribes of Israel. That was their mission, that was their goal, and they were very successful. “their faces shall sup up as the east wind,” Because they came from the east. “and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.” That is the proof: they gathered the captivity.

“And they shall scoff at the kings,” They scoffed at all the kings they found and came across; they didn't give a damn about Montezuma, Atahualpa. “and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold;” Whatever stronghold we had, among the Incas and the Mayans that had many strongholds, they tore into them things. Esau came with armor and they thought these dudes were invincible, until one of them, in Puerto Rico, said let's drown one of them and see if he is a god. They held him underwater with all his armor on till the last bubble came up: he's not a god, they're not gods. They went crazy going after Esau, but even then Satan was rolling with Esau; Satan said don't worry, I got this. “for they shall heap dust, and take it.”

“Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.” Who was the god he came with? Cesare Borgia as Jesus Christ. Look at the face: they are already doing the sign of the cross. They gave credit to their god; this is not the God of our people. Then shall his mind change: after he is done raping, robbing, pillaging and destroying, he said come to Jesus, Jesus loves you, this I know, for the Bible tells me so. The women know that damn song.

The Chaldeans of Habakkuk 1 are a metaphor for the conquering of the Americas, because of what Deuteronomy 28:46 says. “And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” So the curses of Israel, going into captivity, being conquered, would constantly happen.

The words of God are double in wisdom. Pay close attention. “And that he would shew thee the secrets of wisdom, that they are double to that which is!” God's wisdom, his words, are double in meaning to what is written. So you will read something and some of these things have double meanings: the Chaldeans in Habakkuk 1 are the ancient Cushites and also the so-called white man conquering the Americas.

“Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.” We all need to be jacked up and put to death, but he ain't dealing with the Israelites that way. We better be grateful for that.

sense.text: “And when he had opened the second seal, I heard the second beast say, Come and see.” Now we discuss the second seal. Again, the first four seals go into the rise of Esau and the establishing of Babylon.

“And there went out another horse that was red:” This red horse goes with the red horses of the first chariot in Zechariah 6:2. Why red? The first came out red, all over like an hairy garment, and they called his name Esau (Genesis 25:25). “and power was given to him that sat thereon to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another: and there was given unto him a great sword.” The red horse takes away peace from the earth, that is very key, and he had a great sword. Listen to the prophecy given to Esau regarding the sword: by thy sword shalt thou live (Genesis 27:40). That is how Esau lived; that is how he got into the fatness of the earth, the best places, and as the dew of heaven, everywhere. How did they get everywhere, South Africa, Puerto Rico? Not by voting: they pillaged, raped, robbed and murdered. They came with the sword. It was not democracy; it was all war. They covet fields and take them by violence (Micah 2:1-2), because it is in the power of their hand; that was the blessing given unto them. The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart; softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords (Psalms 55:21): that is Christianity. Come to Sunday school, come learn Jesus, then you have a sword in your neck. They came with white Jesus; we closed our eyes, and when we opened them we had white Jesus and they had the land, because we always had the scriptures: look at the Los Lunas Decalogue Stone in Mexico, the commandments written in ancient Hebrew, and the relics found in Puerto Rico written in ancient Hebrew that the Jewish scholars will not admit are authentic, because Puerto Rico's history would change forever.

By thy sword shalt thou live means they were given the art of war. Whatever Esau sees, he makes into weapons: the Chinese had fireworks, and Esau said you can make that into weapons. Even in Genesis, Cain's descendants, Tubal-cain, saw iron and made weapons; the wicked are the ones that came up with that.

Power was given unto him to take peace from the earth. You have to think about that. The dragon gave him his power, and his seat, and great authority (Revelation 13:2): Esau rolls with the damn devil. Haitians talk about voodoo, we're going to pray to the devil against you; the white man goes, I am the devil. You ever notice voodoo doesn't work on Esau? General Butt Naked in Liberia was an expert in voodoo, and it did nothing against Esau; Esau just laughed and gave him guns. And by peace shall destroy many (Daniel 8:25): Esau is always planning, always five steps ahead of black people. Oh, we love you, God loves you, here's some foreign aid; then you end up dead. You want to know how you got jacked up and in poverty like that? Your friendly neighborhood white man.

precepts.why: The red horse goes with Zechariah 6:2. “In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;” So we are dealing with the red ones now. Remember what Revelation 6:4 said: the red horse takes away peace from the earth, that is very key, and there was given unto him a great sword. Genesis 25 shows why it says red.

Why does it say red? “And Isaac intreated the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and the Lord was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived. And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If it be so, why am I thus? And she went to enquire of the Lord. And the Lord said unto her, Two nations are in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and the one people shall be stronger than the other people; and the elder shall serve the younger. And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb. And the first came out red,” The first came out red. “all over like an hairy garment; and they called his name Esau.” They called his name Esau. That is what we wanted there. Now think back to what it said about this red horse: he would take away peace from the earth, and he would have a sword.

Listen to the prophecy that was given to Esau regarding the sword. “And Esau said unto his father, Hast thou but one blessing, my father? bless me, even me also, O my father. And Esau lifted up his voice, and wept. And Isaac his father answered and said unto him, Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above; And by thy sword shalt thou live,” By thy sword shalt thou live: that is how Esau lived. That is how he got into the fatness of the earth; the fatness of the earth means the best places, and as the dew of heaven means they would be everywhere.

But you have to ask how they got everywhere. How did they get in South Africa? They didn't get there by voting. They pillaged, raped, robbed and murdered; they came with the sword. How did they get in Puerto Rico? With the sword. Wherever they went, they got there by the sword. It was not voting, it had nothing to do with democracy; it was all war.

What does it mean, by thy sword shalt thou live? Meaning they were given the art of war. China is given credit for gunpowder, although it was the Moors; they had fireworks, and Esau saw that and Satan said you can make that into weapons. Whatever Esau sees, he says we can make this into weapons. Even when you read Genesis, Cain's descendants, Tubal-cain, saw iron and said we can make these into weapons. Genesis tells you the history of how all that started with the wicked; they are the ones that came up with that.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it, because it is in the power of their hand.” Why is it in the power of their hand? Because that was the blessing given unto them, by thy sword shalt thou live. “And they covet fields,” They covet fields, “and take them by violence;” They take them by violence. “and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” So they oppress a man and his house.

These are various precepts about this red horse with the sword that would take away peace from the earth. “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter,” That is Christianity. “but war was in his heart:” But war was in his heart. He said come to Sunday school, come learn Jesus, then you have a sword in your neck; you're dead. People in the world say they came with the Bible and we had the land, and at the end of it they had the land and we had the Bible. No, we have to clean that up: they came with white Jesus, we closed our eyes, and when we opened them we had white Jesus and they had the land, because we always had the scriptures. Look at the artifacts in Mexico, the Los Lunas Decalogue Stone, those big boulders with the commandments written all in them in ancient Hebrew. And the brother in Puerto Rico who found those old relics, all those artifacts written in ancient Hebrew: all the Jewish scholars will not admit those are authentic, and we told them, if you admit that is authentic, Puerto Rico's history is going to change forever. Damn demons. You see how they try to cover that information up; these are the Edomite scholars saying this, but then you have Negroes saying the same damn thing, following after their master, the same as that mess they try to speak about the northern kingdom.

“his words were softer than oil,” That is Christianity: our God loves us all, everyone. “yet were they drawn swords.” Yet were they drawn swords. That is the blessing God gave Esau.

Power was given unto him to take peace from the earth; you have to think about that. Revelation 13 says something very similar. “And the beast which I saw was like unto a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion:” All this is Esau; the beast with the seven heads and the ten horns has been touched on already. “and the dragon gave him his power,” That is what we wanted to get: the dragon gave him his power, “and his seat, and great authority.” Satan. Esau rolls with Satan, rolls with the devil, rolls with the damn devil. You have Haitians talking about voodoo, we're going to pray to the devil against you; the white man goes, I am the devil. You ever notice voodoo doesn't work on Esau? A prisoner in Haiti was into voodoo, but when the white man came to get him overnight, it did not work. General Butt Naked, the guy we met in Liberia, was an expert in voodoo, but it did nothing against Esau; for some reason Esau just laughed. Esau was giving him guns: that means Esau is the real devil, sending these little soldiers to do his thing.

To take peace from the earth. Remember Habakkuk 1:11, then shall his mind change: Esau will make like they love you, it's all good, but then you end up dead. Esau is always planning something; they are always five steps ahead of black people. “And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many:” By peace shall destroy many. Oh, he destroyed many nations by peace: oh, we love you, God loves you, here's some foreign aid, we love you; then you get death. You want to know how you got jacked up and in poverty like that? Your friendly neighborhood white man.

sense.text:
“And when he had opened the third seal, I heard the third beast say, Come and see. And I beheld, and lo a black horse;” This black horse goes with the black horses of the second chariot in Zechariah 6:2, and deals with the dark nations, all they term as black people, primarily in Africa. There are many black precepts, but you know them already off the top of your head. Write this down: the black horse represents world economics, being just with economies.

“and he that sat on him had a pair of balances in his hand.” This man that sat on this horse is the same red man that was in the verse before, the same man that went forth conquering. The pair of balances: God said to Israel, to the Levites particularly, ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure; just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin shall ye have (Leviticus 19:35-36). Those are all measuring things; when it comes to money and weight, everything, God was telling us we have to be just. We must have a pair of just balances.

“And I heard a voice in the midst of the four beasts say, A measure of wheat for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny; and see thou hurt not the oil and the wine.” Now they are telling you just weights: a measure of wheat for a penny, three measures of barley for a penny, and don't do unrighteously when it comes to oil and wine. But this white man, as we have seen, is not just. He will conquer a nation, take it over, and then change this whole verse. He goes to Sierra Leone, where all your diamonds are, or Ghana, where you get the majority of gold, and says your money is garbage compared to our money: in Sierra Leone 10,000 equals one American dollar; we were counting all that money and it was three dollars. They take trillions of dollars' worth of diamonds from Sierra Leone, then say not only is your money garbage, we are going to give you a million dollars in foreign aid as a loan, and you have to pay it back. How can we pay this back? We have nothing. But Esau conquered, he takes away peace from the earth and he has the sword, so the blacks have no power and can't say nothing; you better suck it up or we will shut everything down. He sets up policies where the natives cannot even manufacture their own resources; they have to outsource that, then pay for it when it is sold back to them, take out a loan, and the loan has debt attached, so the countries constantly go into a vortex of debt. France takes 500 billion dollars a year out of Africa, then lets them borrow 18 million. When it comes to the world economy they are very unjust; this is what God is saying would be in these last days.

Lamentations 5:1-4 shows it: our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens. God calls the white man the real aliens; they are busy talking about the Mexicans as aliens. Oh no, Mr. White Man, you are the real aliens. We have drunken our water for money: when Spain took the land, you want to drink water, pay me. In Bolivia, in the documentary Even the Rain, the people who couldn't afford a bottle of water collected rain water that came from the heavens, and the government taxed them for it, and it caused a whole revolution. Our wood is sold unto us: this is going into economics. We look at the conquest and think it is nothing, but that is a trickle effect all the way up to today; nothing has changed, it just got more and more clever. The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; he shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him (Deuteronomy 28:43-44): he came into our house and got above us in our house, and in our house he lends to us with our own resources, our wood, our water, our bauxite, our gold, our diamonds. Foreign policy guarantees this.

The End of Poverty shows it. When the settlers moved from Kenya in 1964-65 up to 1970, they benchmarked their operations in Europe, so Africa became the producer of raw materials and they became the agents for marketing and processing; all the value addition of the crops was done away from Africa. And if a nation doesn't want to play ball? See thou hurt not the oil and the wine. The economic hit man said it himself: if we don't like what a democratically elected leader of another country is doing, for example opposing the exploitation of oil in his country, someone who looks like me walks into that president's office and says, I can make you and your family very, very rich if you play our game, or I can see to it that you are thrown out of office or assassinated if you decide to fulfill your campaign promises. Every one of those presidents knows what happened to Arbenz of Guatemala, Allende of Chile, Roldós of Ecuador, Lumumba of the Congo, Torrijos of Panama. You think America is this holy Christian nation; they laugh at black people in gangs. My man Esau is the gangster; they run the world. He does global robbery; we ain't on that level. When he says we can make you very rich, what people don't realize is they have already messed up your ability to use your own resources; they take that away first, then say we will give it back if you play our game. From this pocket they offer a few hundred million dollars in corruption, or from this pocket subversives and jackals to overthrow the government or assassinate the president: Torrijos' plane mysteriously crashed into a mountain; Lumumba's friend was paid to assassinate him; Hugo Chavez, who said he smelled sulfur at the United Nations after Bush spoke and sold cheap oil to the ghettos here, mysteriously had an aneurysm and died, and now the poor in Venezuela dig in trash cans for food; add Gaddafi to that list. And this man is not saying Democrat or Republican, because they are all in it together: good cop, bad cop. Obama, the Democrat, played the good cop; Trump, the devil, plays the bad cop. Ten things about Gaddafi they don't want you to know: in Libya a home was a natural human right, so when you got married you got a house, not an apartment, unlike America where you pay property tax on your own house; education and medical treatment were free, and if you couldn't get the course or the treatment in Libya you were funded to go abroad; he built the world's largest irrigation project, the Great Man-Made River, to make water available to all Libyans; it was free to start a farm, with land, livestock and seeds free of charge; mothers with newborns were given 5,000 dollars; electricity was free; petrol was 14 cents a liter, because the proceeds from the oil went to the people, not to himself; literacy went from 25% to 87%, which Kwame Nkrumah tried to do in Ghana in the sixties and they shut him down too; Libya had its own state bank with 0% interest loans and no external debt, while most of Africa has to send a large portion of its money to France's central bank; and the gold dinar, a single African currency linked to gold, following Marcus Garvey who first coined the term United States of Africa, which would have thrown the world economy into chaos, because you don't need Esau any more. The IMF and the World Bank are located in Washington DC, right across the street from each other; they control the world economics from Washington DC, and if you don't play ball with them you are finished. “The stranger that is within thee” First of all he is an alien; the alien comes among us. The End of Poverty shows an example of that. When the settlers moved from Kenya in 1964-65 up to 1970 they benchmarked their operations in Europe, so Africa became the producers of raw materials and they were the agents for marketing and processing; all the value addition of the crops was done away from Africa. Coffee and tea: Germany, which does not have a single bush of coffee, is the largest exporter of coffee. They are the devil the Bible speaks of. They took the coffee, paid the people pennies on a bushel to pick it, processed it, and now you have Starbucks at five dollars a damn cup. The tea you consume in Sudan goes first to Europe, then Lipton brings it back to Sudan. One of the legacies of colonialism is that the poor countries of the third world continue to export raw materials while Europe and North America export finished products; this stems from a practice developed long ago, with the intention that the third world remain backward and dependent and never able to develop, and it gets worse each year. They do that to make sure these nations can never rise above the poverty level. In Africa Esau only allows twelve countries to manufacture small weapons; the rest, you are not allowed, and if you do, we cut you off from the world and you die in poverty. Remember what the Clintons did to Haiti with the rice: bread, oil and rice are the things people use every day, and destroying them makes a country fall into deep poverty, so now you have to buy from them. In Sierra Leone something like 60% were illiterate: when you are poor, your kids can't go to school, because not only do they have to pay to go, they have to go out and work to bring a little bit of money to the house. From colonial times to this day.

sense.text: “And when he had opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth beast say, Come and see.” The fourth seal now.

“And I looked, and behold a pale horse:” That pale horse precepts with Zechariah 6:3, the grisled and bay horses of the fourth chariot; grisled goes into pale horses. “and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” This horse represents death, and hell followed with him. That is Esau; that is all going into Esau, the rise of the white man. First he conquers, then he takes away peace from the earth, he destroys your economics, and once all that happens, death and hell follow right behind them. Habakkuk 2:5 says he transgresseth by wine, and the wine is his lies, his philosophies, his policies (Micah 2:11); he is a proud man, the pride of your heart has deceived you; he keeps not at home, he doesn't mind his business and stay in his own land; he enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death. You accept this man's policies, you follow his philosophies, God is telling us this man is death. Once they introduce whatever it is into your country, like in Kuwait, where they introduced Christianity, celebrating Christmas, open porn stores, the country goes down spiritually, mentally, morally, and especially economically. He cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, heapeth unto him all people: once he destroys your land he extends the olive branch, come to my land, be a citizen here, the land of opportunity; all the people that have been bombed and destroyed have no choice, let's go to America. That is America.

“And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth,” What is the fourth part? This man has conquered the earth. Ezra says of the fourth beast, the eagle, that it remainest of the four beasts, whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them (2 Esdras 11:39-40): the end of the world is going to come through this Edomite beast, the destruction of their world. The fourth came and overcame all the beasts that were past, Babylon, Media-Persia, Greece, and Rome is an extension of America, and had power over the world with great fearfulness, over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression, and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit. So the fourth part is not just Africa: they had power over the world. Daniel 7:7 says the same thing: a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly, with great iron teeth. “to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.”

precepts.why:
“Yea also, because he transgresseth by wine,” This wine represents philosophy; Micah 2:11 shows wine makes reference to lying, falsehood. God said about the white man, the pride of your heart has deceived you. “neither keepeth at home,” Does the white man stay and mind his business in his own land? His desire is as hell, and he is as death, because once they introduce whatever it is into your country, like Kuwait, they didn't want Esau in there, because not only did they introduce Christianity, they are celebrating Christmas now, they opened porn stores, and the people say what have you done to our country. “and cannot be satisfied,” This man, God says, cannot be satisfied. “but gathereth unto him all nations,” Because once he destroys your land, he extends the olive branch: your land is destroyed, your economics are destroyed, you can come to my land, be a citizen here, we can make you very rich, it is the land of opportunity. Now all the people that have been bombed and destroyed have no choice: let's go to America. “and heapeth unto him all people:” That is America.

How do we know the wine in Habakkuk 2:5 is philosophy? Somebody in the back is asking; there might be an Israelite camp that says wine means alcohol and tobacco, something stupid like that. “If a man walking in the spirit and falsehood do lie, saying, I will prophesy unto thee of wine and of strong drink;” You are walking in the spirit and falsehood and lie, saying I will prophesy unto thee of wine. The pale horse precepts with Zechariah 6:3. “And in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grisled and bay horses.” See that part, grisled: that goes into the pale horses.

Power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth. What is the fourth part? Remember this man has conquered the earth. “Art not thou it that remainest of the four beasts,” They are the fourth beast; that is what it is going into. “whom I made to reign in my world, that the end of their times might come through them?” The end of the world is going to come through this man, this beast right here, this Edomite beast. When it says the end of their times, it is talking about the destruction of their world.

“And the fourth came, and overcame all the beasts that were past,” The fourth beast, that eagle, came and destroyed not only Babylon, but who came next: Media-Persia, Greece, Rome; and Rome is an extension of America. “and had power over the world with great fearfulness,” See that: had power over the world. So when you read about the fourth part and ask, is it just Africa? It said they had power over the world. “and over the whole compass of the earth with much wicked oppression;” With much wicked oppression. “and so long time dwelt he upon the earth with deceit.”

2 Esdras 11 goes with Daniel 7:7; it is saying the same thing. “After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it;”

When a cop kills a black kid, every time the parent comes out they say let's all be at peace, let's just love each other. Mike Brown's mother said burn this down, and the Jackal took her in the back: not only will we charge you and your husband for all the destruction, you will spend the rest of your time in jail; she had to recant. “And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season,” We are in that little season right now; this is the time we are in. sense.text: “And I beheld when he had opened the sixth seal,” The sixth seal has not come yet; as we read down you will see what the sixth seal is. We are in the fifth seal, not the sixth. “and, lo, there was a great earthquake;” That great earthquake is in Revelation 11:12-13: when the elect that repent of their sins, men, women, boys, girls, are told come up hither, what the church calls the rapture, and ascend up to heaven in a cloud, a chariot, and the nations see us rise in these chariots, the same hour, the same exact time we are taken up, was there a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell. “and the sun became black as sackcloth of hair, and the moon became as blood;”

“And the stars of heaven fell unto the earth,” That is talking about their satellites. Pay attention to verse 13. “even as a fig tree casteth her untimely figs, when she is shaken of a mighty wind.” Isaiah 34:4 says the same: all their host shall fall down, their satellites, their jets, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.

“And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together;” This is destruction, World War III. The heaven departed as a scroll: that is that mushroom cloud. The heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll, and my sword shall come down upon Idumea, the Greco-Roman word for Edom, and upon the people of my curse (Isaiah 34:4-5). This whole thing is about the destruction of Idumea: that goes with the white horse, the red horse, the black horse, the pale horse, then comes destruction. “and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.” You all living on them islands: God doesn't care if you are in Jamaica, the Bahamas, Puerto Rico, Santo Domingo, Haiti. It says every island were moved out of their places. Bye-bye. There will be no land there; it will just be hot boiling water with burnt fish and burnt submarines and burnt sailors.

“And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;” This is about the underground bunkers. The federal government is ready for the moment of disaster: as mushroom clouds plume, key politicians and federal staffers will be rushed underground. The sites are humming along with daily activity right now and hidden from the public; if you are invited, you already know it; if not, you are on your own. Like the movie 2012, where they made giant ships and a lottery: no, this is for key people in the government, this ain't for the average Negro or Latino on the street; you are going to be ashes to ashes, dust to dust. A reporter for Washingtonian Magazine came into possession of a federal employee's badge with driving directions on the back; Google Maps showed nothing there, but in West Virginia the road dead-ends into the side of a mountain, a guard shack, a chain-link fence and concrete bunker doors, not on any map or in government records. The most famous is Raven Rock, close to Camp David on the Maryland-Pennsylvania line, renovated recently and operating 24 hours a day, every day of the year: a hollowed-out mountain with a freestanding city inside, three-story buildings, a fire department, a police department, medical facilities, a dining hall serving four meals a day, expanded after 9/11 to hold as many as 5,000 people; and more facilities hidden around the country, some known, some secret. They have a police department down there, so in case a Negro finds his or her way in, you are going to be dealt with. These are the government's Cold War doomsday plans, everything that would happen during and after a nuclear attack and how the US government would rebuild afterwards, and these plans are all still in effect today, the same plans that would guide them in a war with North Korea or Russia: a whole network of bunkers around Washington, Raven Rock in Waynesboro, Pennsylvania, and Mount Weather, the civilian government bunker in Berryville, Virginia, hollowed-out mountains with small cities built inside, with a network of helicopters and planes to evacuate officials out to the mountains, and dozens of others scattered around the United States. Certain people you might think would get in probably won't. This shows you the Bible is real.

Every bondman: the only bondman going in there is your servant; your slave might come with you. Remember the Twilight Zone episode where one man in the neighborhood built an underground bunker, and when the alert came that a nuclear war was coming the whole neighborhood was beating down his door, just let my children in, and he kept screaming it only holds three people. We laugh, but that is the reality. To black people this is entertainment, while the people of God are scared; this is real life. There is not going to be no place to run and hide: the white man has a designated place, they have been prepping since before we were born, they have underground cities, there are numerous books on it. That proves the white man knows the Bible; he knows it is true, because he cannot stop this, it is written in the book, so he is prepping for something. You people, the only place you can hide is in the Bible, with God. It is an easy escape; it costs you no money; all you have to do is give your soul over to the Most High God. Where are black people going to go? He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty (Psalms 91:1): that is the place. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow, the missile, that flieth by day, nor for the pestilence, the diseases and sickness that come from these weapons, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday, the bombs, the mushroom cloud (Psalms 91:5-6). God already has his own plan. They created these bunkers for the elite; your project dudes ain't coming in, your gang dudes ain't coming in. Sister, that day the mattress will not help you, hiding in the bathroom and putting water on your head is not going to help you. You have to be in the shadow; God is going to protect you. And you women talking all that filth about your husbands: you are going to have to cover your head that day.

The kings of the earth, the great men, the rich men, the chief captains, the mighty men, every bondman and every free man: these are the same people in Revelation 13:16-17, small and great, rich and poor, free and bond, the merchants, the businessmen and women dealing in commerce, the wealthy, the elites. Bondmen are the third world country leaders, free men the free world, Europe. These are the elite, the wealthy that hide themselves; not the ratchet Negro woman and man having barbecues, eating chicken and collard greens. No, you are going to die here, straight up. Them nuclear bombs are as hot as the surface of the sun; no mattress is going to stop that, no mountain is going to stop that. Bombs now can destroy lands as large as Texas and France; it erases the land, nothing is left. The 911 is over; there is no gin or vodka falling from the sky, it's wormwood; their welfare system is over. Everything they allowed the black woman to have a big mouth about, that day is going to be over. And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, the pride of Edom brought low, the power they gained with that great sword brought down to nothing, the satellites and technology completely destroyed, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day; they cannot stop him (Isaiah 2:17). They shall go into the holes of the rocks and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, running from God, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth, when he allows those bombs to drop and shakes the earth himself; in that day a man shall cast his idols of silver and gold to the moles and to the bats: they are going to try to run to their gods to save them, and they ain't going to save them; are they going to be eating bats and getting the coronavirus? That day when they come out of the bunker they are going to see the pure black man: oh, what happened to black people, why didn't they get burnt? No, they're coming for you; knock on the mountain door. Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: don't rely on the white man to save you; he can die just like you; he will be dead along with you for relying on him (Isaiah 2:19-22). John got this from Isaiah; everything John saw in Revelation you read in Isaiah, and it is a wonder Isaiah didn't lose his mind.

“And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?” So let the congregation say amen.

This talks about the great earthquake. “And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them,” Talking about the elect that repent of their sins, men, women, boys and girls. “Come up hither.” Come up hither: this is what the church calls the rapture. “And they ascended up to heaven in a cloud;” In a chariot. “and their enemies beheld them.” The nations are going to see us rise in these chariots.

“And the same hour” The same hour, meaning the same exact time as we are taken up, “was there a great earthquake,” A great earthquake: this is what we read in Revelation 6:12. “and the tenth part of the city fell,”

“And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll:” This is what we just read in Revelation 6:14. “and all their host shall fall down,” Their satellites shall fall down, their jets shall fall down. “as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.” We read the same thing in Revelation 6:13 about the sixth seal. It is saying the same thing; he is not saying anything different.

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea,” Idumea is the Greco-Roman word for Edom. “and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” So this whole thing is about the destruction of Idumea. That goes with the white horse, the red horse, the black horse, the pale horse, then comes destruction. That is what is going to happen.

Where are black people going to go? The Bible has the answer. “He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.” That is the place: under the shadow of the Almighty. Psalms 91:5-6 proves it is talking about being away from these weapons.

Further proof that the secret place of the most High is away from these weapons. “Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night;” In the secret place of the most High you shall not be afraid. “nor for the arrow that flieth by day;” Nor for the missile that flieth by day. “Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness;” The pestilence, diseases and sickness and all that is going to come from these weapons. “nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” That is the bombs, the mushroom cloud and all of that. So where are we going to be? In the secret place. God already has his own plan. They created those bunkers for the elite; your project dudes ain't coming in, your gang dudes ain't coming in. Sister, that day the mattress will not help you underneath it; jumping in the bathroom, hiding in the bathroom, putting water on your head is not going to help you that day. You have to be in the shadow; God is going to protect you. And you women talking all that filth about your husbands: you are going to have to cover your head that day.

It is the same people we read earlier; these are the ones that are going to be hiding. Not the people in the ghetto having barbecues, eating chicken and collard greens: the wealthy people, businessmen and women. Remember it said bondman and free. “And he causeth all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and bond,” Small and great, rich and poor, the same thing; third world countries, the free world. “to receive a mark in their right hand, or in their foreheads: And that no man might buy or sell,” Those are the merchants; these are the businessmen and women dealing in commerce, the wealthy, the elites. Back in Revelation 6:15, the kings of the earth, the great men and the rich men, great and rich; the chief captains and the mighty men; every bondman, third world country leaders; and every free man, the free world, Europe. They hid themselves. These are the elite, the wealthy, not the ratchet Negro woman and man. No, you are going to die here, straight up, and them nuclear bombs are as hot as the surface of the sun. No mattress is going to stop that; no mountain is going to stop that at all. They said bombs now can destroy lands as large as Texas and France; it erases the land, it's gone. That is why Isaiah says the islands will be moved out of the way: there will be no land there, just hot boiling water with burnt fish and burnt submarines and burnt sailors. So there is going to be no place for the sisters or the brothers who ain't right; the 911 is over, there is no gin or vodka falling from the sky, it's wormwood; their welfare system is over. Everything they allowed the black woman to have a big mouth about, that day is going to be over.

John got this from Isaiah. Isaiah saw a lot of stuff; it is a surprise he didn't lose his mind, because everything John saw in Revelation you read in Isaiah. Verse 17 is going into Edom again. “And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down,” That is this pride being brought low, falling down. “and the haughtiness of men shall be made low:” The power they gained with that great sword will be brought down to nothing; they are going to lose all their power. The satellites, the technology are going to be completely destroyed; no power at all. “and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.” Only God will be exalted in that day. They cannot stop him.

“And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth,” That is the bunkers in the video. “for fear of the Lord,” Running from God; that is what it is saying. “and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.” When he allows those bombs to drop; when he shows up here and shakes the earth himself.

“In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;” Now all of a sudden they are going to try to run to their gods to save them, and they ain't going to save them. Are they going to be eating bats, getting the coronavirus, whatever the hell virus it is? That day, when they get out from underneath the bunker, they are going to see the pure black man: oh, what happened to black people, why didn't they get burnt? No, no: they're coming for you. Knock on the mountain door.

“To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.”

Watch this verse 22. “Cease ye from man,” Don't rely on the white man to save you. Cease ye from man. “whose breath is in his nostrils:” Who can die just like you. “for wherein is he to be accounted of?” Because he is gone; he will be dead along with you, for relying on him.

sense.text:
Brothers and sisters, you think it is a light thing going over Revelation and bringing out what the Bishop just did. That is not a light thing. You are getting knowledge and understanding and wisdom that has been hid for centuries. If you go to any one of these churches they are not going to give you the understanding of Revelation that just came out; you are not going to find this understanding anywhere on the planet earth.

“Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.” Revelation, that whole book, is about parables and secrets that the Most High has inside here, and what does the Lord do? He revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets. So you all know who the prophets are: the prophets are back on the earth today, to go through Revelation and explain it so plain where even a babe could understand it. We know the prophets are back on the earth today.

When the Bishop brought out the black horse with the unjust scales, you think they are not listening right now and seeing what we are bringing out in the scriptures, the prophecies? The same thing they did to these leaders of these countries, you think they are not going to try to do it to us? But the thing is, would you all support us, or would you all turn your back on us when they come for us? Gaddafi's people, a lot of them turned on him; all those leaders, their people turned. That is their job, to make the people turn against you. Would you all stand for us when they come for us? Christ prophesied on that thing. A lot of people here, like was said in the noon class, are on the fringes; that doesn't mean they are real brothers, real sisters. A lot of demonic spirits surround us as we speak. But come to Revelation and understand it as plain as the Bishop breaks it down: every word you read in the Bible, they are going to do just that. We learned that today. They are not going to miss a tone; they are going to follow it as it is written, because God said the power was given to them to do this, the power was given to them to do that. Everything God said, that is what these men are going to do; he is not going to go outside and do his own thing. God set it up like that.

For you who lost hope, today should be the day your hope comes right back up. For you who don't have enough faith, today should be the day your faith gets stronger. These people, don't worry about it: whenever they come for us, don't worry, I'll see you again. They are just killing the flesh, that's it; they don't have power over your spirit, your soul. Always remember that. Don't give these people no power; they are not going to do a damn thing unless the Lord gives them power to do it. We know we have some agents listening, some agents in here: this is what you are going to put to your superior. Christ is coming for you.
